datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2019, classifying geographic areas by food insecurity phase. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at the administrative level, with multiple scenarios provided for each month.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys, providing near-term projections of acute food insecurity across administrative regions.
